import re
import zlib
import hashlib
import math
def score(program: str) -> float:
    toks = set(re.findall(r"\w+", program)) or {"x"}
    mins = [min(zlib.crc32((s + t).encode()) for t in toks) for s in "abcdefghijklmnop"]
    return sum(mins) / len(mins) / 4294967296.0
